expected.report:
SPECIMEN:
(A) Descending colon polyp
(B) Colon polyp

MICROSCOPIC EXAMINATION:
(A)  Sections show a polypoid fragment of large intestinal mucosa with predominant villous architecture and low grade dysplasia. There is no evidence of invasive malignancy.

(B)  Sections show large intestinal mucosa with architecturally distorted serrated crypts, which show basal dilatation and serration extending into the crypt bases, in keeping with a sessile serrated lesion / adenoma. No cytological dysplasia is identified. There is no evidence of invasive malignancy.

DIAGNOSIS:
(A) Descending colon, Descending colon polyp, polypectomy - Villous adenoma with low grade dysplasia.
(B) Colon, Colon polyp, polypectomy - Sessile serrated lesion / adenoma.
